description:
Change an MCP server, or which of its tools agents may call. Only the fields you send are changed.

Requires scope `mcp_servers:write`.

auth.description: How to authenticate to the server. Replaced as a whole when sent.

headers.description: For type headers, e.g. [{"name":"Authorization","value":"Bearer ..."}]. Values are write-only. On update, omit a value to keep the stored one.

oauth.description: Only for servers that do not allow dynamic client registration, or to ask for specific scopes.

type.description: none for a public server; headers to send an API key; oauth for a server that signs in.

enabled_tools.description: Names of the tools agents may call. Replaced as a whole. When never set, only tools the server marks read-only are enabled.

name.description: The app's name as a caller would say it, e.g. "HubSpot". The agent is told this name.

transport.description: Leave as auto unless the server only speaks one.

url.description: The remote MCP endpoint, e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp. Must be public https (or http) on port 443 or 80.

name: update_mcp_server
title: Update an MCP server
